children: SAID ON TUESDAY SIGNED BINDING AGREEMENT WITH PT METALOGIKA REKYASA SISTEM TO ESTABLISH MANUFACTURING PLATFORM IN INDONESIA
PT METALOGIKA INTENDS TO ESTABLISH THIN FILM FLEXIBLE SOLAR PANEL PRODUCTION FACILITY IN INDONESIA WITH INITIAL PRODUCTION CAPACITY OF 20 MW PER YEAR
MIDSUMMER WILL SUPPLY MANUFACTURING EQUIPMENT AND RELATED SERVICES FOR ESTABLISHMENT AND OPERATIONS OF SOLAR CELL FACTORY TO JOINT VENTURE
MIDSUMMER WILL ASSUME MINORITY OWNERSHIP IN JOINT VENTURE
